reason: The existing mapping provides a defensible and sufficiently complete regulatory basis. Article 9 establishes the risk management system, which includes testing (Art. 9(6)-(8)). Article 15(1) requires consistent performance throughout the lifecycle, and Article 17 mandates a quality management system that includes procedures for managing modifications (Art. 17(1)(a)). Article 72 supports post-market monitoring. Together, these provisions cover the control's requirements for testing, approval, and management of changes to models, prompts, knowledge bases, plugins, and security.
applicability_note: This control is applicable to all systems under the EU AI Act, and the cited provisions apply to providers of high-risk AI systems, which are the primary entities responsible for implementing these controls.
challenge_comment: The mapping is comprehensive, covering the entire lifecycle from development testing (Art. 9) to ongoing quality management and change control (Art. 17) and post-market monitoring (Art. 72). No gaps were identified in the provided evidence.
